summary: One Secure Agility camera (281) at Erskineville Rd/Swanson St covers 13 zone sites; the Railway Pde (W) footpath zone (356) counts every bike twice for the whole record (no odd count in 100k slots) and is halved, the feed's omitted zeros are filled, and nine camera-wide outages (notably 5-27 Mar 2024 and 6 May-20 Jun 2025) are set missing. The camera's level stepped up sharply on 24 Jan 2024 and again on 2 Oct 2024 with no matching change at nearby counters; these are recorded as uncertain because nothing shows which level is right. Each counter-direction is split into three series at those steps (to 2024-01-23, 2024-01-24 to 2024-10-01, from 2024-10-02) so no trend runs across them.
